objective: CHAIN-STEP-20261127-001 (refereed) found that ordinary growth gives 4,213 of 5,111 growing census starts a chain of eight carrying the step one layer up by round 6 (59.5% of all starts). For G18, count the same under the two rival laws A129 (one_fewer) and A130 (arity_floor) on the full census, rounds 0 to 6, with the carried step checked on the whole stage.
title: Comparing growth laws on the step one layer up: chains of eight under the forbidding cuts
